name: INMP441 I2S MEMS microphone
description: Digital microphone (I2S, 24-bit): the board records sound from it over I2S. Generic audio input for anything that listens: level meters, clap detection, recording, streaming. Wire SCK, WS and SD to three free GPIOs and pass them to the I2S driver; L/R to GND puts it on the left channel. In the simulator its sound is set by props (silence, a tone, noise, or a sample clip), or by a test.

pins.label: SCK
pins.description: Bit clock from the board (I2S BCLK).

pins.label: WS
pins.description: Word select from the board (I2S WS / LRCLK).

pins.label: SD
pins.description: Serial data out of the mic. To the board's I2S data in pin.

props.label: Sound
props.description: What the microphone hears: quiet room, a sine tone, broadband noise, or the sample clip in 'clip_b64'.

props.label: Loudness
props.description: Sound pressure at the microphone. 94 dB SPL reads -26 dBFS (datasheet sensitivity); speech at 1 m is about 60 dB.

props.label: Clip (16-bit PCM, base64)
props.description: Mono 16-bit little-endian PCM at 16 kHz, base64. Played in a loop when Sound is 'clip' (a scenario or the agent sets it; the browser can fill it from the microphone).

bindings.description: The board reads samples from it (last 100 ms).
Level of what it hears, dBFS.

mechanical.source: common INMP441 round breakout; the sound port is on the bottom of the module

sourcing.package: INMP441 MEMS (4.72 × 3.76 mm LGA) on a 14 mm breakout
